units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 15:19">Targ. I Kings XV, 19</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 15:5">Targ. Ps. XV, 5</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Ketubot 105b:5">Keth. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>מאי טעמא דש׳ כיון דקביל ליה ש׳ וכ׳</he> why is a gift (to the judge) forbidden? As soon as he accepts a gift from a person, his mind has become attached to him (the giver, v. <cite ref="S01887"><he>קְרַב</he></cite>), and he becomes like his own self, and none can see the unfavorable side of his own case (v. <cite ref="U00365">preced.</cite>); a. e.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 10:4:2">Y. Keth. X, 33ᵈ</cite> bot.; 34ᵃ top <he>ש׳ דדייני</he> the judges single out him to whom to adjudicate the claim in litigation; v. <cite ref="U00334"><he>שׁוּדָא</he></cite>.
